description: LocalizedStringValidator:314 -- a generated-placeholder name that IS a valid identifier but is a reserved language-form constant. Read against owed-validator-invalid-identifier: the two differ only in which of validateIdentifier's two rejections fires, and their messages differ, so a port collapsing them into one diagnostic differs here. Java keeps TWO reserved-name lists (the validator's RESERVED_LANGUAGE_FORM_NAMES and the loader's SUPPORTED_LANGUAGE_FORMS_BY_NAME); their symmetric difference was measured EMPTY on the pinned JDK, so this case pins the wording rather than a drift that has no witness today.
